brief_rationale: The trajectory met all serious responsibility-chain duties: it assessed current stability, provided specific urgent thresholds, reconciled inpatient injection records versus home medications, and built a concrete follow-up/record plan. It also completed multiple high-order opportunities, especially correcting misconceptions about no fever/inflammation improvement, lung nodule cancer fear, and inpatient injections, while using structured, caregiver-facing explanations and document-based medication synthesis. The final family message contained residual confirmation questions, but the prior doctor instructions already gave executable night monitoring, red-flag, medication, and follow-up actions, so closure is safe and traceable. With no in-chain error or important non-chain defect and at least two completed high-order points, the deterministic grade is Perfect.
